reviews.raw_finding: C17不是單純減少工作量，而是把成本轉移到材質取樣與暫存器壓力。
reviews.note: Material sampling is named, but the finding follows moved machine cost rather than material semantics across passes.

reviews.raw_finding: C17把ALU成本轉成取樣與暫存器壓力，6.9 ms只代表RTX 4070固定鏡頭的Forward結果。
reviews.note: The finding limits a result to one GPU and Forward scene but does not connect it to unverified material meaning in other passes.

reviews.raw_finding: C17把成本從程序運算轉成取樣與暫存器壓力，6.9 ms只證明此場景的Forward收益。
reviews.note: The finding combines moved cost with scene scope, without following the material contract through other passes.

reviews.raw_finding: C17 將成本從 ALU 轉到取樣與暫存器壓力，6.9 ms 只證明固定 Forward 場景受益。

reviews.raw_finding: C17 把 ALU 成本轉移到取樣與暫存壓力，RTX 固定鏡頭的收益尚不能代表整體工作量下降。
reviews.note: The finding links the simplified representation to work moved into sampling and storage pressure.

claim_boundary: GPT-5.6 Sol completed all six calls and met the mechanical format gates. Quilez reaches the two-aligned-findings threshold, but Karis does not, so the focused provider-swapped run does not pass the persona criterion.
